title: Tasks
description: Scoped grants of authority assigned to agents.

createDialog.title: Create a task
createDialog.description: Assigns an agent a narrowly-scoped grant of authority. Root tasks (no parent) start every delegation chain.
createDialog.descriptionPlaceholder: Optional context for auditors and approvers.
createDialog.grantsHint: Each row grants one tool action against a resource pattern ("*" for any resource). Cross-joined server-side into the task's effective grant set.
createDialog.noGrantsYet: No grants added yet — the task will be created with no allowed tool actions.

detail.name: Name
detail.grantsNote: manar-api's task list/detail surface returns task metadata but not the effective allowed-tool-action/resource grant set this phase — grants are enforced server-side (AuthorizationService) but not currently exposed via any GET endpoint to display here.
detail.noParent: This is a root task — it has no parent.
detail.notFoundBody: No task with this ID was found in this workspace's task list.

revoke.dialogDescription: Immediately invalidates this task and every descendant (delegated) task. This cannot be undone from this console.
